'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
***At least 43 [[Palestinians]] are killed from [[Israel]]i attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 26 people in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/19/live-gaza-war-escalates-as-israel-defies-global-condemnation (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Siege of El Fasher]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] attacks a mosque at an [[internal displacement]] [[refugee camp|camp]] with a [[drone warfare|drone strike]] near [[El Fasher]], [[North Darfur]], killing 75 people. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-rsf-drone-strike-kills-dozens-in-darfur/a-74060598 (DW)]
*[[Insurgency in Manipur]]
**Two [[Assam Rifles]] personnel are killed and five [[Assam Rifles]] personnel are injured in an ambush by [[People's Liberation Army of Manipur]] militants in [[Bishnupur]], [[Manipur]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/assam-rifles-truck-ambushed-on-outskirts-of-imphal-confirms-army-9308221/ (NDTV)]
*[[Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria]]
**At least 11 [[Nigeria Police Force|police officers]] are killed in an ambush by armed assailants in [[Benue State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://thestreetjournal.org/bodies-of-8-missing-policemen-recovered-after-deadly-attack-in-benue/ (The Street Journal)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Canada]] bans the [[Irish people|Irish]] band [[Kneecap (band)|Kneecap]] from entering the country, citing statements and alleged links to [[List of designated terrorist groups|designated terrorist groups]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgrvw4ejn4o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three workers are killed in an explosion at a silo operated by waste management company Ecopartenope near [[Caserta]], [[Italy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-workers-deaths-waste-plant-explosion-naples-dbd4e6f626bfa904f7a1d7341a495bf9 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 in the United States]]
**The [[United States]] [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]]'s (CDC's) [[Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices]] unanimously votes to abandon its recommendation for the [[COVID-19]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] and now recommends that [[Americans]] get the vaccine based on their personal choice. In a separate vote, the committee votes for the CDC to communicate clear risks about COVID-19 vaccines. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/cdc-hepatitis-bvaccine-vote-delayed-parents/story?id=125731004 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Estonia–Russia relations]], [[Russia–NATO relations]], [[Violations of non-combatant airspaces during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Estonia]] summons [[Russia]]'s [[chargé d'affaires]] after three [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Mikoyan MiG-31|MiG-31 fighter jets]] enter its [[airspace]] near [[Vaindloo]] unauthorized, prompting a [[NATO]] response from [[Italian Air Force]] [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35s]]. [https://apnews.com/article/british-intelligence-mi6-russia-war-443df0c37ff2254fcc33d5425e3beaa6 (AP)]
*[[International sanctions against Iran]], [[Snapback mechanism of sanctions against Iran]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] (UNSC) convenes to vote on a draft [[United Nations resolution|resolution]] concerning [[Snapback mechanism of sanctions against Iran|the snapback of sanctions]] on [[Iran]]. Nine UNSC countries voted against lifting Iran sanctions, four in favor. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-snapback-sanctions-nuclear-united-nations-e01bdcaf62c4144ff56731fed8144915 (AP)]
*[[France–Mali relations]]
** [[France]] suspends its joint [[counterterrorism]] agreements with the [[Mali]] government over the arrest of a French citizen. According to Mali officials, the French citizen was taken into custody for their alleged involvement in a purported [[Coup d'état|coup]] plot. Also in response to the arrest, two Mali diplomats are expelled from an embassy in [[Paris]] by French authorities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/19/france-suspends-counterterrorism-cooperation-with-mali (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Ireland–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] and the [[United Kingdom]] agree to replace the [[Northern Ireland Troubles (Legacy and Reconciliation) Act 2023|Northern Ireland Legacy Act]] with new laws that will establish investigative bodies to address [[List of people killed during The Troubles (1969–1998)|killings]] during [[The Troubles]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2025/09/19/ireland-the-troubles-agreements/3711758321160/ (UPI)]
*[[Morocco]] becomes the 60th [[UN member state]] to ratify the [[High Seas Treaty]], allowing it to enter into force in January 2026. [https://apnews.com/article/high-seas-treaty-marine-diversity-15061c0624d8e472603401b479870904 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of World War II]]
**[[World War II bomb disposal in Europe]]
***Around 10,000 people are ordered to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] after authorities discover two pieces of [[World War II]]-era [[unexploded ordnance]] in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], one in the [[Spree River]] near [[Mitte]] and another in [[Spandau]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-thousands-evacuated-in-berlin-over-2-wwii-bombs/a-74053192 (DW)]
*[[Detention of Barbie and Peter Reynolds]]
**[[British people|British]] couple Peter and Barbie Reynolds are freed in [[Afghanistan]] after being detained by the [[Taliban]] for 8 months. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-couple-freed-by-taliban-after-qatari-mediation-official-says-2025-09-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Chinese people|Chinese]] journalist [[Zhang Zhan]], previously jailed for reporting on the early [[COVID-19 pandemic in China|COVID-19 outbreak]] in [[Wuhan]], is sentenced to an additional four years in [[Penal system in China|prison]] on charges of [[picking quarrels and provoking trouble]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinese-covid-whistleblower-sentenced-4-more-years-jail-group-says-2025-09-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Palestine|Palestinian]] [[Palestinian Authority|authorities]] arrest Hicham Harb, a suspect in the 1982 [[Chez Jo Goldenberg restaurant attack]] in [[Paris]] that killed six people, after [[France]] issued an [[Interpol notice]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250919-palestinian-authorities-arrest-key-suspect-in-1982-anti-semitic-paris-attack (AFP via France 24)]
